build.//: outputs = nx's defaults (dist/build/public) plus lib/, which tsdown emits; without it a cache hit reports success without restoring lib/ to disk
build.//inputs: the shared tsdown config and the tsconfig.base.json that every package's tsconfig.lib.json extends live outside project roots; without it a warm cache serves stale output when it changes

test.//test: the shared vitest base/setup live outside project roots; without these inputs a warm cache serves stale results when they change. testExtras is empty here; a project whose tests read files outside its root names them in its own namedInputs (see packages/core/project.json)
